## 2026 assessment

[Read the assessment online](2026/assessment.html){.btn .btn-primary}
[Download the assessment PDF](2026/assessment.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

**Version: November 9, 2026 · Review draft · Table 2 links and Table 56 notation corrected**

The HTML and PDF present the same assessment revision. The HTML provides
interactive figures and navigation; the PDF provides a paginated copy for
reading and printing. This review draft presents Model 26.0 as the working
assessment; final scientific adoption and harvest advice follow the assessment
review process.

The report includes the updated 1991–2026 prohibited-species, groundfish, and nontarget bycatch tables,
the current Appendix H introduction, and portrait layouts
for narrower PDF tables. Supporting references available only in the authors’
local working files appear as text rather than download links. Manual
accessibility review remains pending.

## Development and previous years

[Browse development material and previous years](development.qmd), including

## Weight-at-age development comparisons

[Doubling 2025–2026 BTS observation CVs](2026/weight-at-age-bts-cv-sensitivity.qmd)
shows the remade heatmap, age-3 comparison, and numerical checks for a separate
WtAgeRE sensitivity. These comparisons retain their original inputs and
projection baselines.

[Model 26.0 projection comparison: 2020–2024 empirical fishery weights](2026/projection-empirical-weight-comparison.qmd)
uses the same five-year mean for catch and SSB weights, with the original
assessment and projection results retained for comparison.

[Extended projection comparison with original and doubled-BTS-CV WtAgeRE weights](2026/projection-re-weight-comparison.qmd)
compares both forecasts with the published baseline and empirical means,
including a matched control for the effect of doubling the BTS CVs.
